text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her sights set on challenging the Classic Triple Crown next year,
Symboli Rudolf increases her training intensity even further than before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we're pushing so hard,
ideally during breaks, I'd want her to
just rest without thinking about anything, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. In that case,
we can consider the equipment inventory verified... check.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I'm reviewing the requests from the students.
I had the vice president compile all the feedback."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, since opening the online suggestion box,
we've been receiving far more feedback than before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we intend to keep operating the suggestion box,
but it is the duty of the administration to provide a wide variety
of formats to keep up with the times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm glad to see her talking so happily,
but seeing her work even during training breaks
makes me genuinely worried for her health."
choice_data_list: I want you to focus on resting your body for now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your concern is entirely justified,
but that is simply my troublesome nature.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When I'm not working,
I get anxious, and that actually tires me out more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm the sort they call a workaholic.
Just chalk it up to personality and cut me some slack, will you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...When she asks, it's hard to say no.
As I wonder how I should respond..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President?!
I knew it...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Air Groove.
What's the matter? Is there a problem?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is. From what I can see, Madam President, you are currently in the middle of training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Just like I let you know this morning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was informed.
That is why I also noted in the email to 'check in the evening.'

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And yet, for some reason, the reply came back as "Confirmed."
I thought it was strange and came to check on you, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I just happened to be free during my break.
If it's something I can check right away, I'd rather just take a look.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Having free hands during break time
is so you can actually take a break!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, don't fret so much, Air Groove.
I appreciate your concern, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With you in such a fury, it will be quite difficult to introduce you to Trainer-kun as my brilliant right hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "And that's the situation, Trainer-kun. Allow me to introduce her to you once more."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She's Air Groove. In terms of title, she's the Vice President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They are comrades who envision an ideal similar to my dream and walk alongside me.
Proud comrades-in-arms, you might call them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It's Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove.
Known as "The Empress," she is one of the most
prominent and capable figures at Tracen Academy.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We'll have more opportunities to see each other from now on.
Please make sure to get along.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is one more member I'd like to introduce,
but... that can wait for later.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is all well and good, President,
but our conversation is not over yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware that the President wishes
to fulfill her duties with her own hands.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"However, would you at least allow me
to decide the priority of what we check?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But if we do that,
it will only add to your workload.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you honestly think I would resign myself to that
and make you shoulder the responsibilities that are mine to bear?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No. If it is the President,
I am sure she can devise a solution herself."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your understanding. Don't worry, just focus on fulfilling the job I assigned to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, please at least focus
on your training for today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sounds good, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I apologize for disturbing you.
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...How is that for brilliant talent?
I am truly fortunate to have someone of her caliber
working alongside me."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, if she's the one saying so, I have no choice.
Let's focus on the rest of the training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, increase the weight on the barbell.
choice_data_list: Even now, it's quite a heavy workload, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I can still keep going.
If I'm doing this, I might as well push myself to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew... No doubt about it,
I'm gonna be sore tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Muscles, ache. Muscle, ache.
Got muscle pain, it's a pain to put on clothes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad, I suppose?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After an intensely grueling training session, as we were walking around the academy grounds...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-kun, stop right there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian!
What happened to the task I asked of you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Symboli Rudolf suddenly called out
toward the tree—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume jumped down...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: How did you know?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The moment I stepped onto this street,
there was a faint sound from above.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I merely deduced that anyone hiding from me in such an energetic manner would most likely be you."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... You really are a pain.
That's why I didn't want you finding me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Don't be so cold, now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, this is Narita Brian.
The other student council member I mentioned earlier.
Though I imagine you already know her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Narita Brian. Just like Air Groove earlier, her running prowess is guaranteed.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Is that all you needed?
I'll be on my way, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hold on, I haven't heard about your duties yet. Have you finished inspecting the equipment?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it now.
...Ah, that reminds me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The General Affairs person looked troubled about something, don't know what though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
General Affairs is...? 
Understood. I will go support them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
People mistake her for arrogant and unapproachable, but she's actually very caring.
There's a lot of work that only she can handle.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, one of the general affairs girls, huh... Right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's the other way around. That general affairs kid is someone who recently
joined the student council, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They looked up to me and said
they wanted to fight tooth and nail alongside me for the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everything takes time to bear fruit; naturally, they aren't used to the duties yet,
so we are supporting them for now, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Having the ambition alone is enough.
The presence of those who follow me is my encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That day turned out to be one where I learned
of Symboli Rudolf's feelings toward the Student Council members.
